about.headline: Your Neighbor, Not a Faceless Agency
about.intro: I build websites for local trades and service businesses across Erath County. Air Force veteran, Texas-raised, with a background in tech and project management — which means I don't just make things look good. I make sure the whole process is smooth, on time, and on budget.
about.body1: When you work with me, you're working directly with the person building your site. No account managers, no outsourced developers overseas, no runaround. I'm right here in Erath County.
about.body2: I understand what local trades need because I live here and I've worked with my hands too. Whether you're a contractor, an HVAC tech, a welder, a builder, or a service company — I know your customers and I know how to reach them online.

faq.subhead: If you don't see your question here, just give me a call or send an email — I'm always happy to chat.

items.q: How long does it take to build a website?
items.a: Most projects take 2 to 4 weeks from our first meeting to launch day. Simpler sites can go faster, and bigger projects with e-commerce or custom features might take a bit longer. I'll give you a clear timeline before we start so there are no surprises.

items.q: Do I own my website when it's finished?
items.a: Yes, 100%. Your website, your domain, your content — it all belongs to you. Most of my clients let me host their site (it's the easy path), but if you ever want to take it somewhere else, you can. I'll hand over the files, transfer the domain to your name, and walk you through getting it set up wherever you want. No lock-in, no hostage situations — that's not how I do business.

items.q: Do I have to use you for hosting?
items.a: Nope. I offer hosting because most local business owners don't want to deal with servers, SSL certificates, and downtime alerts — and frankly, it's just easier for everyone if I handle it. But if you have a tech-savvy nephew, an existing host you like, or just want to do it yourself, I'll build the site, hand you the files, and help you get it live somewhere else.

items.q: What if I already have a website but it's outdated?
items.a: That's one of the most common requests I get. I can refresh your existing site, rebuild it from scratch, or move you off an old platform like Wix or GoDaddy onto something faster and easier to manage. We'll talk through what you have and figure out the best path forward.

items.q: Do you handle hosting and the domain name?
items.a: Yes. I'll help you pick and register a domain (like yourbusiness.com) and get you set up with reliable, fast hosting. You'll always own these accounts in your name — I'll just help you set them up so you don't have to figure it out yourself.

items.q: What do you need from me to get started?
items.a: Honestly, not much. Just a conversation to start. From there, I'll need things like your logo (if you have one), some photos of your work or business, and a basic idea of what you want to say. If you're missing any of that, no problem — I can help you figure it out or even take photos and write copy for you.

items.q: Will my website show up on Google?
items.a: Yes. Every site I build is set up with the basics for local SEO, so when people search for your type of business in Stephenville or anywhere in Erath County, you'll have a real shot at showing up. The Business and Professional packages include deeper SEO work and Google Business Profile setup.

items.q: What happens if something breaks after launch?
items.a: You're covered. Every project includes the monthly retainer, which means I'm monitoring your site, pushing security patches, and handling fixes as part of the deal. If anything breaks, just call me — that's what the retainer is for.

Every project includes a $50/month retainer that covers hosting, security updates, uptime monitoring, content changes (new photos, updated hours, added services — just text me), and a monthly traffic report so you can see what your site is doing. It's less than one service call for most trades, and it means you never have to think about your website — that's my job.

Yes, anytime with 30 days notice. No long-term contract, no early-cancel fees, no fine print. If you cancel, I'll hand over your site files and help you get set up elsewhere if you want. If you ever want to come back, the door's open. I'd rather earn your trust than lock you in.

items.q: Do you only work with businesses in Erath County?
items.a: Erath County and the surrounding areas (Comanche, Eastland, Hood, Somervell, Palo Pinto) are my focus, but I'm happy to work with anyone in Texas or beyond. The advantage of being local is that I can meet you in person — but for projects further away, video calls work just fine.

Simple: 50% up front to start the project, and 50% when your site goes live. No hidden fees, no monthly contracts you can't get out of. I accept check, cash, Venmo, or card — whatever's easiest for you.
